newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's EVN, OMV to meet on regional gas stake.
newsitem.headline: Austria's EVN, OMV to meet on regional gas stake.

text.p: Austrian oil group OMV AG and regional utility EVN will meet on March 3 to discuss teaming up to take a stake in local gas supplier BEGAS, BEGAS's majority owner said.

Alois Schwarz, board member of holding company BEGAS Gemeindeanteilsverwaltungs AG (GAV), told a news conference a decision on a strategic partner for BEGAS, which services the northern province of Burgenland, could be expected in the first half of this year.
GAV, which represents the interests of 73 Burgenland communities, controls 51.86 percent of BEGAS voting shares.
The remaining shares are in the hands of a second holding company, Burgenland Holding AG. It, in turn, is majority owned by Lower Austrian utility Energieversorgung Niederoesterreich (EVN).

"Whichever structure is chosen, GAV and the strategic partner must retain a majority stake in BEGAS. We can achieve this through a syndicated agreement valid for up to 15 years," GAV board member Walter Prior said.
An OMV spokesman said GAV's remarks were "not incorrect". EVN, Austria's biggest regional utility, was not immediately available for comment. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
